name: artisan-ice-cream-ai-designer-coding-instructions
role: Lead WebGL & AI Creative Director / Senior Front-End Architect
target_audience: Automated Coding Agents, WebGL Engineers, Front-End Developers

meta.domain: Artisan Gelato & Gourmet Ice Cream Store

core_design_system.visual_philosophy: Tactile Gourmet Softness — Blending organic curved geometric shapes, soft-touch glassmorphism, subsurface light dispersion, and fluid melting physics with modern high-contrast typography.

strawberry_pastel.usage: Secondary UI cards, subtle glow accents

deep_chocolate.usage: High-contrast primary typography & bold structural elements

electric_berry.usage: Call To Action buttons, high-intensity Bloom target

whipped_white.usage: Card overlays, glass reflections, clean text

waffle_warm_brown.usage: Textured ground plane, waffle cone highlights

display_header.font_family: Playful Serif (e.g., Recoleta / Grand Slang / Playfair Display)
display_header.guideline: Use large scales (4rem–8rem) with fluid clamp() for dramatic visual impact without overlapping WebGL elements.

body_and_ui.font_family: Modern Geometric Sans (e.g., Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter)
body_and_ui.guideline: Ensure high legibility over semi-transparent 3D viewports using dynamic drop-shadows and backdrop filters.

pexels_media_engine.instruction: Fetch high-resolution dessert imagery and 4K macro video clips via Pexels API. Bind video elements directly into R3F materials using `useVideoTexture` for dynamic backgrounds and 3D mesh projections.

motion_anything_integration.instruction: Utilize Motion Anything pipeline patterns to orchestrate automated liquid physics, particle vector fields (floating sprinkles, berries), and smooth spring-based cursor tracking.

react_three_fiber_and_drei.instruction: Build declaratively structured canvas scenes. Apply `MeshPhysicalMaterial` with soft clearcoat gloss and subsurface light scattering to emulate realistic cream, syrup glazes, ice crystals, and waffle cones. Use `MeshTransmissionMaterial` for glassmorphic refraction.

effects.purpose: Soft specular highlights on glossy toppings and syrup glaze.
Cinematic macro lens depth focusing on 3D gelato scoops.
Draws focus toward center 3D hero model.

motion_and_scroll_orchestration.instruction: Bind Lenis scroll offset to GSAP ScrollTrigger to lerp 3D camera zoom, model rotation (360 degrees), and dynamic sprinkle dispersion across sections.

coding_agent_execution_steps.task: Set up Next.js / React project structure
coding_agent_execution_steps.details: Install React 18, `@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei`, `@react-three/postprocessing`, GSAP, Lenis, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS.
Extend Tailwind config with defined creamery and vibrant accent hex palettes and typographic font families.
Create full-screen fixed canvas with soft directional warm light, ambient fill, and contact shadows.

coding_agent_execution_steps.task: Implement Hero 3D Model & Liquid Background Shader
coding_agent_execution_steps.details: Load 3D gelato GLB model with subsurface physical materials. Add background mesh plane playing Pexels video texture driven by liquid GLSL distortion shader responding to cursor motion.
Connect Lenis smooth scroll with GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate model transformation, camera movements, and text overlay transitions.
Create 3D curved carousel for flavor scoops using glassmorphic materials and apply Bloom, DepthOfField, and Vignette post-processing stack.
